name: Sorbitan Esters
aliases: E491, E492, E493, E494, E495, sorbitan monostearate, sorbitan tristearate, sorbitan monolaurate, sorbitan monooleate, sorbitan monopalmitate, sorbitan esters
what_is: A family of sorbitan fatty-acid ester emulsifiers identified in the EU as E491–E495.
why_botia: BOTIA groups these declarations because each E-number corresponds to a different sorbitan ester and labels may use either the E-number or common chemical name.
can_1: Detect E491–E495 and the corresponding sorbitan ester names.
can_2: Show the texture and E-number layers for the declared family member.
cannot_1: Determine concentration or the origin of the fatty-acid feedstock from the ingredient list.
cannot_2: Assume all sorbitan esters are chemically identical or used at the same level.
